localChanges: The interface's colours now come from a theme. The game looks just as it did, and adding ?theme=slate to the address previews a new slate-and-brass look, the first step of the interface polish (closes #736).
If importing the game's files fails, the reason now shows in the window's dark red rather than bright red.

Options now has a Colours setting: Light, Dark or System default. Until now the sidebar and top bar followed your system's setting only, and the choice now reaches every window and the city screen under the slate-and-brass preview too (closes #706).
